_meta.description: sGTM Server Container configuration spec for iampatterson.com Phase 1-2 + Phase 6 Demo Events
_meta.note: This is a configuration spec, not an importable GTM container export. Use this to manually configure tags/triggers/variables in the sGTM container on Stape, or as the basis for generating an importable container JSON.
_meta.capturedNote: Regenerated from the live Default Workspace. This file describes what is live; edit it to change the container, then apply. Prose notes are preserved across a capture; everything else comes from the container.

clients.name: GA4 Client
clients.note: Standard sGTM GA4 client. Receives GA4 hits from the web container and parses them into sGTM's Common Event Data model. This is what getAllEventData() reads from.

clients.name: Stape Data Client
clients.note: Stape's proprietary client for routing events to external destinations. Used by the BigQuery write tag. Already provisioned by Stape during setup.

triggers.name: ce - conversions
triggers.note: Fires on conversion events only. Used by simulated ad platform tags.

triggers.name: clientName - GA4
triggers.note: Fires for every event received by the GA4 client. Used by the GA4 forwarding tag and BigQuery write tag. (Carried from the spec entry named "All GA4 Events" during the 2026-09-08 capture: the spec named this tag aspirationally and live built it under its own name.)

tags.name: Meta CAPI - Simulated
tags.note: Simulated Meta Conversions API tag. Logs the payload that would be sent to Meta's /events endpoint without making an HTTP request. Maps: purchase→Purchase, add_to_cart→AddToCart, trial_signup→StartTrial, form_complete→Lead. Requires a custom sGTM template to be created and attached after import.

tags.name: Google Ads Enhanced Conversions - Simulated
tags.note: Simulated Google Ads Enhanced Conversions tag. Logs the conversion payload (conversion_action, value, order_id, hashed user_data) without making an HTTP request. Requires a custom sGTM template to be created and attached after import.

tags.name: Pub/Sub Publish
tags.note: Publishes every event to Pub/Sub for the real-time SSE pipeline. The Cloud Run event-stream service (infrastructure/cloud-run/event-stream/) subscribes via a push subscription and routes events to the matching browser session. The message is base64-encoded JSON in the Pub/Sub message envelope. See infrastructure/pubsub/README.md for the full message schema. (Carried from the spec entry named "Pub/Sub - Publish All Events" during the 2026-09-08 capture: the spec named this tag aspirationally and live built it under its own name.)

tags.name: BigQuery API
tags.note: Writes the full getAllEventData() payload to BigQuery. Column names must match the schema in infrastructure/bigquery/schema.json. Fields not matching a column are silently dropped (ignoreUnknownValues: true). The 'received_timestamp' field is populated by the tag's getTimestampMillis() — INT64 epoch ms. (Carried from the spec entry named "BigQuery - Write All Events" during the 2026-09-08 capture: the spec named this tag aspirationally and live built it under its own name.)

tags.name: [Stape] GA4 - Base
tags.note: Forwards all events to GA4 via Measurement Protocol. Includes all event parameters (ep) and user properties (up). IP not redacted at sGTM level — GA4 handles its own anonymization. This is the same pattern as Stape's auto-generated '[Stape] GA4 - Base' tag. (Carried from the spec entry named "GA4 - Forwarding" during the 2026-09-08 capture: the spec named this tag aspirationally and live built it under its own name.)
